The test `test_margin_normalize` checks whether the DataFrame is correctly normalized when passing specific arguments to the `crosstab` function. However, this test fails with a KeyError indicating that "Sub-Total" not found in axis. 

Following the execution path, we find that the error occurred at line 615 where it tries to drop the "margins_name" which in this case is "Sub-Total". But before this operation, at line 613, the DataFrame table has already been modified by dropping all occurrences of "margins_name", including the one in the axis.

Consequently, when trying to drop "margins_name" again, it raises a KeyError because "Sub-Total" does not exist in the new axis. The test failure indicates that the method `crosstab` is not correctly handling the normalization when passing specific arguments.
